data.name: ReportConfirm
data.value: This opens your email client to send a report to llxmod@foxmail.com (body copied to clipboard as backup). False reports may affect review. Continue?

data.name: ReportSuccess
data.value: Opened your email client; report body copied to clipboard. Send to llxmod@foxmail.com. If no mail app opens, paste the body into a new message yourself.

data.name: ReportFailed
data.value: Could not open the email client

data.name: SubmitModConfirm
data.value: Open your email client to submit to llxmod@foxmail.com?

data.name: SubmitModSuccess
data.value: Email client opened. Fill the template, attach .dll (optional preview.png), and send to llxmod@foxmail.com.

data.name: SubmitModFailed
data.value: Could not open the email client

data.name: SubmitGuideBody
data.value: Subject must start with one of these prefixes (copy-paste): • [Mod投稿/Submit] new mod • [Mod更新/Update] update existing • [Mod举报/Report] report • [管理器建议/Feedback] feedback One email = one request. Maintainers review and upload to the catalog — no Fork/PR required. (Advanced users may still open a PR.)

data.name: SubmitGuideTip
data.value: For Submit/Update: attach .dll (optional preview.png). If attachments are huge (~>40MB), put a netdisk link in the body. Do not send source unless asked.

data.name: SubmitGuideOpen
data.value: Open full guide / 打开完整教程

data.name: SubmitGuideOpenEmail
data.value: Open submit email / 打开发送投稿邮件
